decisions.reason: As a large established German software firm, we are likely to continue the inbound SMS API because it has been publicly maintained on its own page across two years, indicating visible commitment and enough investment to justify giving it more time.

The email-to-SMS gateway is still very new and prominently presented on its own page, so management would tend to attribute any weak early traction to temporary market development rather than withdraw quickly.
The SMS-to-email gateway was also only recently launched and publicly committed to, making it likely that management persists with it for at least another year instead of reversing course early.
